ml_1m.note: Non-zero values mean the split is chronological PER USER but not globally time-blocked: pooled training events postdate some users' held-out events and are visible to ALS, PPMI and the decayed popularity counts. This is standard for leave-last-out recommender evaluation and is reported, not repaired; a globally blocked replication needs one cutoff date and discards much of the corpus.
